scope.evidence_basis: Live verify response emitted 2026-10-17 by the production worker (v2.3.0, ATC/1.0) at https://uta-trust-api.eddyflores100.workers.dev against the published conformance vector valid-atc (ATC-TEST-VALID-001, signed by the frozen ca-test-1 anchor; vectors-only throwaway CA). Settlement: 0.01 USDC on Base Sepolia (eip155:84532) via the public x402.org facilitator, transaction 0xc7467392f0ca06c8a92d877d7224290186b35e63dece7fcd9a1c64c4971844f7, receipt carried in the X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. The card is a published test vector and asserts nothing about any real agent.
scope.purpose: Reviewer-requested evidence for the `emitted` claims in the crosswalk: the endpoint requires payment, so this fixture records a real paid 200 response. The digest is independently checkable WITHOUT paying — sha256 over the published canonical JCS bytes (valid-atc.canonical.txt in the UTA repo) equals the digest the response carries.

request.payment: X-PAYMENT header carrying an x402 v2 payload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization, USDC eip155:84532, amount 10000 = 0.01 USDC, payTo 0xfD856E89Ac88757C339c67E9717528af0cD1d7Ee)

verify_response.service_signature: none — the response is deliberately unsigned; only the digest and the rail receipt travel with it

settlement_receipt.carried_in: X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header (issued by the facilitator/rail, not signed by this service)

canonical_bytes.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JCS over the signed subtree (the card without its signature key)
canonical_bytes.published_source: UTA repo, uta-monorepo/packages/conformance/vectors/ (valid-atc.canonical.txt, valid-atc.bytes.hex, valid-atc.sha256; index _index.json schema 1.7.0, published 2026-09-09)
canonical_bytes.note: sha256(published canonical bytes) == verify_response.digest — any third party can recompute and re-verify the signature step without paying for a verification.

finding.conclusion: The response is exactly an identity-layer verification status, so the primitive is present and `emitted` is accurate. But the canonical definition (Grade 1-3, KYC presence, principal endorsement) is broader than the artifact, so `exact` overstates the correspondence. Recorded as `partial` with the missing properties listed; this fixture stays as the checkable evidence for what `emitted` covers.

corrected_entry.inference_basis: Live 200 response for the published vector valid-atc: verified true, risk low, four per-stage outcomes, sha256 digest equal to the published canonical-bytes hash, settlement receipt on-chain (Base Sepolia tx 0xc7467392f0ca06c8a92d877d7224290186b35e63dece7fcd9a1c64c4971844f7).
